domain: food-safety enforcement - agricultural sample residue-noncompliance prediction (Chile, SAG pesticide-residue monitoring)
prediction_question: HYPOTHESIS at close: given a fruit/vegetable sample taken by SAG's monitoring programme (commodity, origin, region, season, programme), predict whether it will be non-compliant (unauthorized residue or above national MRL) - a targeting signal for risk-based sampling. Not openable this tick: the publisher's sample-level results are published only inside PDF reports, and no licence statement covers them.
prediction_time: Undetermined - the sampling reports are annual PDFs; per-sample field documentation (which columns exist at sampling time vs lab time) is only inside the PDFs, and no machine-readable schema exists to state a prediction instant. Recorded as unresolved, not as satisfied.
target_definition: PROPOSED: binary sample non-compliance (residue above MRL per Resolucion 33/2010, or unauthorized use). Measured from publisher reports: 2009-10 programme 1,639 samples, 10 unauthorized (0.4%), ~1% MRL non-compliance; 2025 programme 9,390 samples (PDF summary tables). Sample-level rows are NOT published machine-readably - only aggregate/summary tables inside PDFs.

sources.license: no licence statement found for this data (see license_evidence)

sources.api: CKAN package_search measured 2026-10-23: 'residuos plaguicidas' = 0 datasets; 'plaguicidas' = 3 datasets ('Listado de Plaguicidas' - the registered-products list, SAG, licence cc-nc; two regional applicator registries). None contain the residue-monitoring sample results.

license_evidence.note: No terms/licence text found on the SAG monitoring page or in the report PDFs for the residue-monitoring results (read 2026-10-23). The national catalog carries no entry for this data; SAG's other catalog entries are marked cc-nc (non-commercial). Unstated + no machine-readable distribution = class C under the standing triage policy, and the format blocker stands independently.

measurements.probe_2026_10_23: Web + catalog probes: sample-level results exist only as PDF report tables (2025 report: 9,390 samples; 2009-10 report: 1,639 samples, 0.4% unauthorized, 99% MRL compliance). datos.gob.cl: 0 entries for 'residuos plaguicidas'. Volume IF machine-readable would be ~9k samples/year over ~15 years, positives ~0.4-2% - plausible but unmeasurable from PDFs.

rejection_reason: DROP (status dropped), decisive evidence: (1) FORMAT - the sample-level residue results are published only inside annual PDF reports; no machine-readable distribution exists on the SAG page or the national catalog (datos.gob.cl search measured 0 relevant entries), so no schema, prediction instant, or split counts can be computed from the source; per the discovery skill a PDF-only publisher is not a 'go'. (2) LICENCE - no terms statement covers this data (class C, unstated; SAG's other catalog entries carry non-commercial licences), and under the standing policy new unresolved class-C leads are closed, not parked. This is a publisher-side data-distribution rejection, NOT a scientific rejection of the task shape. REOPEN IF: SAG (or a national catalog entry) publishes sample-level residue-monitoring results in machine-readable form under an open licence - then probe schema, instant and split capacity; the 0.4-2% positive rate measured from the reports suggests capacity would need the multi-year union.
next_action: None (dropped). Reopen condition recorded in rejection_reason. The water-quality sample-positivity shape remains live elsewhere in the portfolio (bvl-zoom-sample-positivity, DE, investigating).
